modal.introduction.title: How Side-by-Side Diff works
modal.introduction.welcome.title: Thanks for installing Side-by-Side Diff
modal.introduction.welcome.description: Compare two text files, review every difference, and save only the changes you choose.
modal.introduction.welcome.feedback.desc: Side-by-Side Diff runs entirely in your vault. Share your ideas or rate the plugin with a GitHub star.
modal.introduction.welcome.reportBug.des: Found something that does not work as expected? A concise report with the steps to reproduce it helps resolve the issue.
modal.introduction.welcome.documentation: The documentation explains comparisons, proposals, editing, saving, and the available review actions in more detail.
modal.introduction.start.title: How to start
modal.introduction.start.description: Start a comparison from the file explorer in either of these ways.
modal.introduction.start.single.title: Compare one file with another
modal.introduction.start.single.descript: Open a text file's context menu and choose “Compare with another file”. Then choose the file for the right side.
modal.introduction.start.single.imageAlt: A file context menu with Compare with another file selected
modal.introduction.start.multiple.title: Compare two selected files
modal.introduction.start.multiple.descri: Select exactly two text files in the file explorer, open the context menu, and choose “Compare files”.
modal.introduction.start.multiple.imageA: A multi-file context menu with Compare files selected
modal.introduction.selection.title: Select the second file
modal.introduction.selection.description: When starting with one file, it remains fixed on the left. Use Select file to choose the right-hand file; your five most recent choices appear first.
modal.introduction.selection.imageAlt: Comparison view with the left file fixed and a Select file action for the right file
modal.introduction.tips.title: Tips and tricks
modal.introduction.tips.description: Use these shortcuts and review tools to work through a comparison quickly.
modal.introduction.tips.keyboard.title: Keyboard navigation.
modal.introduction.tips.keyboard.descrip: Alt+ArrowDown and Alt+ArrowUp move between changes. Alt+ArrowRight accepts, Alt+ArrowLeft ignores, Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes, and Ctrl/Cmd+S saves.
modal.introduction.tips.keyboard.imageAl: Keyboard shortcuts for navigating, accepting, ignoring, undoing, and saving changes
modal.introduction.tips.groups.title: Change groups.
modal.introduction.tips.groups.descripti: Adjacent changes are grouped together. Larger groups offer Accept all and Ignore all, while keeping each decision reviewable.
modal.introduction.tips.groups.imageAlt: A grouped change block with Accept all and Ignore all actions
modal.introduction.thanks.title: Thank you
modal.introduction.thanks.description: This is open source and free because I like it.
modal.introduction.thanks.websitePrefix: You can find more about my work at
